svg.text: Route: /admin/products · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin only (admin site, signed in)
• Search matches name, barcode or category and works together with the category filter. With no match: “No products match … ” and a Clear search / Show all categories button.
• + Add product and Edit open the product form (12b, 12c); Delete asks first (12d). After a save a confirmation bar appears above the table (“Product name added / saved”). Bulk import
